# Community code of conduct

We welcome contributions from people of all backgrounds and experience levels.
Communicate respectfully, explain technical disagreements with evidence, and make room
for questions and different perspectives.

Harassment, threats, discriminatory language, sexualized content, deliberate disruption,
and publishing someone's private information are not acceptable in project spaces.
Never post customer records, credentials or private application data.

Maintainers may edit or remove harmful content, restrict participation, or ban repeat or
serious offenders. Decisions should be proportionate and protect the people affected.

Report conduct concerns privately to the maintainer at
[prabhu.vajjiram@yahoo.com](mailto:prabhu.vajjiram@yahoo.com). Include relevant links and
context without redistributing private information. Maintainers will handle reports
discreetly and avoid sharing identifying details beyond what resolution requires.
